provenance.notice: TMS, SMMS, TDMS, COA and BDMS are internal Indian Railways systems with no external access. The maintenance backlog shown here is generated, not observed. Corridor geometry and protected paths are measured from published data; the daily shape of detention cost is assumed.

constraints.name: Sanctioned window length
constraints.detail: A granted block runs at least the minimum the corridor policy allows and no longer than its window; an ungranted one has zero length.

constraints.name: One sanction per work item
constraints.detail: Each task is placed in exactly one block, or it is deferred and priced as deferred. Nothing is half-scheduled.

constraints.name: Statutory obligation
constraints.detail: Criticality-A work is a hard constraint, solved first. A feasible plan is therefore a proof that every obligation is met, not a claim that the penalty was set high enough.

constraints.name: Due-date compliance
constraints.detail: Statutory and scheduled work finishes on or before the date it is due.

constraints.name: No sanction without work
constraints.detail: A block is granted only if a task uses it. The line is never closed for nothing.

constraints.name: Protection and clearance
constraints.detail: Work starts only after protection is complete and ends before clearance begins. A block does not start when the gang starts.

constraints.name: Line occupation and power-block coupling
constraints.detail: No two blocks hold the same road at once, and a section-scope window enters both roads at once - OHE work takes the section down and pays detention on both.

constraints.name: Machine and gang availability
constraints.detail: One tower wagon, one tamper, two USFD units, gangs and crews, shared across the division. The single tower wagon is the classic binding constraint, and the model finds it without being told.

constraints.name: Blocks per section per day
constraints.detail: A cap on how often one section is taken in a day - controller workload and caution-order churn, not track capacity.

constraints.name: Night-working limit
constraints.detail: A cap on night blocks per section per week, because night working is rationed by gang welfare rules and not only by traffic.

constraints.name: Technological sequence
constraints.detail: Work that must follow other work does: the USFD test precedes the rail renewal it justifies.

placement.restriction: Optimality of the placement, with the set of scheduled work held fixed at what the full solve chose. Does not bound the choice of which work to defer.

pareto.note: Each point is a real re-solve at a different risk weight, under one shared work budget. That budget is coarser than the shipped plan's, so the current-policy point does not reproduce the headline KPIs — it is the same question asked with less compute.
